package.description: A bundle of Windows system exploration and diagnostics tools by Pavel Yosifovich.

en-US.description: A bundle of Windows system exploration and diagnostics tools by Pavel Yosifovich.
en-US.longDescription:
Pavel Tools is a single installer for a suite of Windows internals / sysinternals-style
utilities: Total Registry, Total PE, Object Explorer, Device Explorer, Network Explorer,
WMI Explorer, WFP Explorer, ETW Explorer, Process Monitor X, Pool Mon X, DepWalk (32/64-bit),
.NET Explorer (32/64-bit), Win Spy, CPU Stress, Debug Print, BITS Manager, INF Studio,
Quick Assembler and sysrun.
en-US.name: Pavel Tools
